modals.congratulations:
Congratulations, CP TEAM member! With the changes you suggested, you reduced the risk of future floods. Your city is grateful! You've been trained very well!

Your mission continues…
Can you design a new city that is protected from floods? Get ready for your next mission!

messages.welcome:
CP TEAM member, it's time to act!

In recent months your city has been 'drowning' many times. Roads have turned into rivers, homes have been at risk, shops have stopped operating... The residents are asking for help!

The services have exhausted every solution and are turning to the experts of experts: the CP TEAM members!

They sent you secret reports documenting real flood events but... the information is hidden in riddles and challenges.

What is your mission?
• Solve the riddles and find the correct spots on the map.
• Suggest smart changes that will reduce flood risk.

Time is pressing... The next big storm is approaching...
Will you manage to save the city before it floods again?

The mission starts now! Are you ready?
messages.falseAlarmMessage: You reached the spot but... you can't change anything here. Try again!
messages.correctPoint: Well done! You reached the right spot! What change do you suggest here?
messages.quizFailMessage: That's not the right change. Think again!

quest1.title: Coast
quest1.riddle:
You pick up the phone. A voice recites a passage from the poem 'The Flood' by Kostis Palamas. Where in the city does the voice send you?

The Flood
Rain, you keep crying, and you, silent south wind!
Water everywhere, the flood is the victor;
in the teeth of a monstrous cup
the houses, the streets, the piers, the land, there!

Flood, you will drink everything down here;
your mouth, we too await it.
From the sea we came, to the sea
we shall go. It is the law of life.
quest1.successMessage: Well done! You found the right spot!

quest2.title: River
quest2.riddle: It usually stays on its path. But during the last heavy rainfall, it kept growing and growing and wouldn't stop. Its borders disappeared, the roads became its extension, and cars ended up in the water…
quest2.successMessage: Well done! You found the right spot!

quest3.title: Concrete
quest3.riddle:
In the city there are two areas of equal size. When it starts raining, however, they don't 'react' the same way.

• One keeps the water on the surface, doesn't absorb it easily.
• The other absorbs it faster, before the surrounding area floods.

You need to go to the first area.
quest3.successMessage: Well done! You found the right spot!

quest4.title: River vegetation
quest4.riddle: The river is blue... But does it also have green? It's not water, but it holds it back.
quest4.successMessage: Well done! You found the right spot!

quest7.title: Building ruins

quest8.title: Sea trees
quest8.riddle: You look at the sea and see it turquoise instead of blue. What element around it could be changing its color?

quest9.title: River banks
quest9.riddle:
'If you cover me with concrete,
the river gets angry.
If you leave me free,
I protect the city.'
quest9.successMessage: Well done! You found the right spot!

quest10.title: Sewer grates
quest10.riddle:
'I'm underground and I work non-stop. When it rains a little, I manage just fine.
But when the rain gets angry, I narrow, I choke, and the water looks for another way… above the ground.'
quest10.successMessage: Well done! You found the right spot!
